initialExam.title: UP PCS-J (Judicial Services) 2026
initialExam.description: Uttar Pradesh Provincial Civil Service (Judicial Branch) exam for recruitment of Civil Judges in UP courts.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB Degree, enrolled as Advocate in any Bar Council
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GK, Hindi, English, Law. Mains: Substantive Law, Procedural Law, Evidence, Constitution.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims (150 MCQs) → Mains (4 papers, descriptive) → Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Exam → Mains Exam → Interview → Final Merit
initialExam.jobRole: Civil Judge (Junior Division) in UP courts
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge JD → Civil Judge SD → Additional DJ → District Judge → HC Judge.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit allahabadhighcourt.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
